question: People should look after their health as a duty to the society where they live, rather than for their own benefits. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

In contrast, I also feel that a society filled with patients withincurable diseases and disabled inhabitants will result in resentment and discrimination among community members. For example, some mpoverty-stricken areas have witnessed n the majority of national budget is used to treat diseases. In conclusion, I reiterate my partial agreement that individuals hold the responsibility of taking care of themselves to ftheir communitties. question: In their advertising, businesses nowadays usually emphasis that their products are new in some way. Why is this? Do u think it is a positive or negative development.
essay: As throw-away lifestyle and consumerism  become the dominant  21st century trends, how innovative and novel a product is has already become the most popular advertising strategy adopted by many companies currently. In this eassay, some possible driving forces behind this trend will be proposed along with my attitude toward it.    The most obvious reason is that consumers nowadays are pursuinge innovative and ‘new’ products endlessly.  For consumerism, there has been almost unanimous consensus regarding the assumption that “‘ the newer the better, and that has led to impulsive consumption for newness.  For instance, the recent publish research result, that 80% of people are willing to purchase a mobile phone with newer versions regardless if  the new one has any advancement in the technology or how long they have been using the current one, manifests the impulsiveness of consumers. iIn order to convince consumers , retain their competitiveness and increase their sales revenue,  businesses will try to emphasize the newness of their products in their  promotion campaigns.    I believe whether the development is negative or positive mainly depends on if there is real innovation and novelty in the products.  If there are new elements  or further breakthroughs involved in the design as in the case of the Apple official press conferences, the advertising will bew informative and beneficial for consumers. By contrast, if the emphasis is an exaggeration of the products’ features, the promotion will be rather misleading and deceitful, leading to irrational consumption and impulsive purchases. For instance, a food manufacturing  business might promote a snack with slightly different packaging but the same flavor and ingredients  as a ‘brand-new’ version, which is misguiding fora consumers.    In conclusion, the high demands of consumers for new products are ithe main underlying reasons of f the situation which, I believe, is not instinctively beneficial or harmful. To judge the nature of the development comprehensively, the authenticity of the advertising and the intention of the business should be considered.    323
